li.label: uneasy here
li.description: Something about this place is off. I can't say what.

li.label: unsettled here
li.description: Nothing here is quite the right shape. It's wearing on me.

li.label: wrong place
li.description: I've been here too long. The corridors don't end.

li.label: this place is wrong
li.description: This place is wrong and it doesn't care that I know.

li.label: hollow here
li.description: Everything here feels like a copy of somewhere real.

li.label: the walls are wrong
li.description: The walls repeat. I keep checking whether I've been here before.

li.label: nothing here is right
li.description: Nothing here was made for anyone. It just goes on.

li.label: cannot be here
li.description: I need to be out of here. I need to be out of here.

li.label: this place is eating me
li.description: I can't tell how long I've been down here any more.

li.label: unmade by this place
li.description: There is nothing left of me that this place hasn't got into.
